pr_title: [screengrab] Fix regression with metadata folder structure
pr_body:
Fixes #16050.

<!-- Thanks for contributing to _fastlane_! Before you submit your pull request, please make sure to check the following boxes by putting an x in the [ ] (don't: [x ], [ x], do: [x]) -->

### Checklist
- [x] I've run `bundle exec rspec` from the root directory to see all new and existing tests pass
- [x] I've followed the _fastlane_ code style and run `bundle exec rubocop -a` to ensure the code style is valid
- [x] I've read the [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] I've updated the documentation if necessary.

### Motivation and Context
Fixes https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16050.

### Description
From the issue linked above and from https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/15994 it seems that for some users the path on the Android device contains `"#{locale}/images"` and for some it doesn't. So as a solution, I'm simply checking if it contains this part and add it for the users where it doesn't contain it already.

No one seems to have found out why this difference is happening in the first place, but my best guess is that different Android app or system configurations lead to different behaviors. This PR fixes the issue for both cases.

### Testing Steps
This is a small change and I can't test if it fixes the issue, but the reporters of https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues/16050 could easily check and confirm that this fixes it for them.
pr_comments: We found the fix and will be fixed in #16094 😊

issue_context.title: [Regression] 2.142.0 messed up metadata folder structure
issue_context.body:
<!-- Thanks for helping _fastlane_! Before you submit your issue, please make sure to check the following boxes by putting an x in the [ ] (don't: [x ], [ x], do: [x]) -->

### New Regression Checklist

- [x] Updated fastlane to the latest version
- [x] I read the [Contribution Guidelines](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] I read [docs.fastlane.tools](https://docs.fastlane.tools)
- [x] I searched for [existing GitHub issues](https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/issues)

### Regression Information
<!-- Knowing the breaking versions and last working versions helps us track down the regression easier -->
- Breaking version: [e.g. `2.142.0`]
- Last working version: [e.g. `2.141.0`]

### Regression Description
<!-- Please include what's happening, expected behavior, and any relevant code samples -->
Running `bundle exec fastlane screengrab`, with `locales(['en-US', 'de-DE', 'nl-NL'])` I expect the following folder structure to be generated

```
metadata/android/de-DE/images/phoneScreenshots/*.png
metadata/android/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/*.png
metadata/android/nl-NL/images/phoneScreenshots/*.png
```
Instead I get
```
metadata/android/de-DE/images/de-DE/images/phoneScreenshots/*.png
metadata/android/de-DE/images/nl-NL/images/phoneScreenshots/*.png
metadata/android/en-US/images/de-DE/images/phoneScreenshots/*.png
metadata/android/en-US/images/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots/*.png
metadata/android/en-US/images/nl-NL/images/phoneScreenshots/*.png
metadata/android/nl-NL/images/nl-NL/images/phoneScreenshots/*.png
```

Adding more locales in Screengrabfile adds an increasing amount of excess folders.

This also breaks the screenshots.html. It just shows a blank screen. Seems to be caused by changes in PR https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/15994

I commented this in the issue too but I think the solution here needs to be on line 326 https://github.com/fastlane/fastlane/pull/16063/files#diff-693ac675cd5d301f4c33f1e075c624f4R326

```rb
screenshots_dir_pattern = File.join(pull_dir, '**', "screenshots")
```

needs to be something like

```rb
screenshots_dir_pattern = File.join(pull_dir, '**', locale, **, "screenshots")
```
I think 🤔

`move_pulled_screenshots` now gets run multiple times but its pulling out every locale (currently) because `screenshots_dir_pattern` is not filtering by the newly passed in `locale`

I'm sorry but I don't understand how the change you provided above explains why for some the resulting path was `/en-US/images/phoneScreenshots` and for some just `/phoneScreenshots`. The issue was not that images were overridden, the issue was the path itself. At least I don't understand how the suggestion you make would influence the resulting path ... the only thing that could make sense here is if the `pull_dir` itself was different for the different users. In that case the `gsub(pull_dir, @config[:output_directory])` would be the problem because it would be removing the `/en-US/images` part if the `pull_dir` itself included that.
